nodes.label: CLI Interface Design
nodes.rationale: Defines the planned command-line interface for model and agent management.

nodes.label: Fake Gateway
nodes.rationale: Used for hermetic testing of request interception and model routing.

nodes.label: Measurement M10: Upstream Model Stability
nodes.rationale: Ensures model selection persists through lifecycle transitions like compaction and resume.

nodes.label: subagent-router
nodes.rationale: Small, independent package for explicit model routing for native Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex subagents.

nodes.label: Subagent Model Routing Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: TDD-based implementation plan mapping requirements to 15 specific tasks.

nodes.label: Subagent Model Routing Design Specification
nodes.rationale: Defines normative requirements, decision rules (D1-D11), and measurement criteria (M1-M10) for the routing system.

nodes.label: runCodexPreToolUseHook
nodes.rationale: Stdin/stdout hook for Codex PreToolUse event; issues permissionDecision: deny for unauthorized model selections.

nodes.label: validateCodexSpawn
nodes.rationale: Validates spawn_agent inputs; enforces M9 precedence (explicit model vs role) and requires M7 authoritative witness.

nodes.label: opencodeVariants
nodes.rationale: Generates ROLE@ALIAS variants for OpenCode agents by overriding the native model field with the upstream identifier.

nodes.label: exportConfig
nodes.rationale: Publishes native artifacts and metadata sidecars to a separate directory; sidecars include snapshotGeneration and artifact hashes.

nodes.label: createOpenCodePlugin
nodes.rationale: Executable plugin entry point registering tool.execute.before to enforce runtime guards in OpenCode.

nodes.label: validateOpenCodeTask
nodes.rationale: Validates native task arguments against the catalog; requires authoritative native witness (M6-runtime) for routing decisions.

nodes.label: Marker-Routed Integration Mode
nodes.rationale: Mode where upstreamModel is determined by a handler before the gateway (used by Claude Code).

nodes.label: Native Integration Mode
nodes.rationale: Mode where the native harness model field is the upstreamModel (used by OpenCode/Codex).

nodes.label: Measurement M1: Claude Code Agent ID
nodes.norm_label: measurement m1: claude code agent id
nodes.rationale: Verifies if Claude Code sends unique x-claude-code-agent-id headers.

nodes.label: Measurement M3: additionalContext Injection
nodes.rationale: Determines where additionalContext from SubagentStart appears in requests.

nodes.label: Measurement M6: OpenCode Agent Variant Inheritance
nodes.norm_label: measurement m6: opencode agent variant inheritance
nodes.rationale: Tests inheritance of prompts, tools, and permissions in OpenCode variants.

nodes.label: Measurement M7: Codex PreToolUse Hook
nodes.rationale: Validates Codex hook behavior regarding model validation and denial.

nodes.label: External AI Gateway
nodes.rationale: External service (e.g., 9router, OmniRoute) that handles provider auth and protocol translation.

nodes.label: previewRoute
nodes.rationale: Simulates routing decisions offline with explicit assumptions (authenticatedChild, freshDelegation) for diagnostic purposes.
